sections.heading: Subject interview - 2026-01-27 (S. Whitfield)
sections.body: Enhanced Subject Interview conducted 2025-11-19 under oath. Subject's account of the delinquency (~$9,000) is materially inconsistent with bureau records ($47,300); his characterization of foreign family contact is inconsistent with remittance activity. Transcript and summary placed in file.

sections.heading: Financial - 2026-01-27 (S. Whitfield)
sections.body: Tri-bureau credit data and state court records establish sustained delinquency across five accounts totaling $47,300, including two charge-offs and an unpaid 2025 small-claims judgment of $3,100. Delinquency has continued after re-employment in early 2025.

sections.heading: Foreign contacts - 2026-01-27 (S. Whitfield)
sections.body: Subject's mother and two siblings are resident in Lagos, Nigeria. One sibling's employment with a state-owned enterprise was developed through record checks and was not disclosed on the SF-86. Expanded lead recommended on the sibling's SOE role and subject's contact frequency.

sections.heading: Employment - 2026-01-27 (S. Whitfield)
sections.body: Employment verified: Sentinel Dynamics LLC, 2018-02 to present, Senior Systems Engineer. The 2024 six-month gap is corroborated by employer records as an involuntary layoff; rehired at a comparable grade.

sections.heading: References - 2026-01-27 (J. Ramos)
sections.body: Supervisor and neighborhood interviews favorable: dependable, stable household, no conduct or substance indicators. All sources unaware of financial stress; no source corroborated or contradicted foreign-contact reporting.

sections.heading: Financial - 2026-03-18 (S. Whitfield)
sections.body: Supplemental credit re-check completed at adjudicator request. Delinquency total revised upward after a new collection placement; figures reconciled across TransUnion and Equifax and forwarded to adjudication.

sections.heading: Foreign travel - 2026-05-06 (S. Whitfield)
sections.body: CBP I-94 arrival/departure pair validated for travel to Nigeria, 2026-04-11 to 2026-04-25. No foreign-travel report on file with the FSO as required by SEAD-3. Coworker follow-up corroborates the trip; item referred to adjudication with the travel record attached.
